p: stood up from before his dead: That is, when he had mourned: so the godly may mourn if they do not pass measure, and the natural affection is commendable.
mighty prince among us: That is godly or excellent: for so do the Hebrews speak of all things that are notable, because all excellency comes from God.
went in at the gate of: Meaning all the citizens and inhabitants.
bowed down himself before the people: To show that he had them in good estimation and reverence.
shekels of silver: The common shekel is about 20 pence, so then 400 shekels is equal to 33 pounds, 6 shillings and 8 pence at 5 shilling sterling to the ounce.
by the sons of Heth: That is, all the people confirmed the sale.
